judgment_calls.decision: (clinical_finding "Clinical finding") root concept, so the red-box questions are asked of every patient with anything recorded
judgment_calls.alternatives: An or of all common symptoms and warning signs (a proxy list); a vital-sign measurement as trigger (red box precedes routine vitals)

judgment_calls.topic: 'Ensure the patient ... is seen promptly' box (vital-sign thresholds)
judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded: VHA's lowest priority is Urgent, which the page reserves for the red box
judgment_calls.alternatives: A second Urgent priority evaluation for the thresholds (would rank 'promptly' equal to 'urgent attention')

judgment_calls.decision: Both Sudden onset and Recent qualifiers required on each finding
judgment_calls.alternatives: Sudden onset only (fires more often); add Cerebrovascular accident warning sign (not on the page)

judgment_calls.decision: All red-box items Urgent, as the page says 'urgent attention'; warning signs keep their own higher levels through their own rules
judgment_calls.alternatives: Escalate seizure/chest pain etc. to the warning-sign levels here

judgment_calls.decision: Glucose (red-box management) and RR/SpO2 (if coughing/difficulty breathing) encoded as measure tasks because the page makes them conditional, not routine
judgment_calls.alternatives: Omit as routine vitals per Will's briefing

judgment_calls.topic: Visit timing in the pregnant/hypertension/diabetes branches
judgment_calls.decision: Measure tasks fire whenever the condition is active; booking/every visit/once a year not representable
